subject: skill:frame
gist: The yes is the choice line; standing only where proceed admits
reason: The yes is the choice line written after the proposal, never a request to commit or go ahead; standing holds only where proceed admits the mode. Knowledge-home writes open a quick record; scratch stays under the change's id (J-102 S2).
